title: Howell’s A Grammar of the Classical Arabic Language
text:
About this project
بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم
This is a Quarto book that aims to make Howell’s A grammar of the Classical Arabic Language more navigable.
It reuses files and links from Aasim Iqbal (جزاه الله خيرًا)’s site: https://revivearabic.blogspot.com/2016/03/grammar-classical-arabic-language-howell-arabicgrammar-pdf.html
In order to use, first navigate to the chapter from the sidebar on the left.
It will open a chapter page with two frames:
The frame on the left is an embedded PDF on the combined table of contents. Scroll through it to determine your desired section number.
Click on your desired section number in the frame on the right to open it in that frame. In order to go back to the clickable section list, click the back button on your browser.
